candidates.title: IntraSlice: Towards High-Performance Structural Pruning with Block-Intra PCA for LLMs
candidates.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks but face deployment challenges due to their massive size. Structured pruning offers acceleration benefits but leads to significant performance degradation. Recent PCA-based pruning methods have alleviated this issue by retaining key activation components, but are only applied between modules in order to fuse the transformation matrix, which introduces extra parameters and severely disrupts activation distributions due to residual connections. To address these issues, we propose IntraSlice, a framework that applies block-wise module-intra PCA compression pruning. By leveraging the structural characteristics of Transformer modules, we design an approximate PCA method whose transformation matrices can be fully fused into the model without additional parameters. We also introduce a PCA-based global pruning ratio estimator that further considers the distribution of compressed activations, building on conventional module importance. We validate our method on Llama2, Llama3, and Phi series across various language benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves superior compression performance compared to recent baselines at the same compression ratio or inference speed.
candidates.reason: IntraSliceは残差接続による活性化分布の崩れを避けるためブロック内部にPCA圧縮を適用する構造化プルーニングで、LLMのデプロイ時のサイズと計算を削減する推論向け圧縮として直接貢献する。

candidates.title: CIMERA: Compute-in-Interconnect and Memory with Reconfigurable Precision for LLM Inference
candidates.venue: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems
candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) impose significant computational and memory demands, creating challenges for energy-efficient inference across platforms ranging from data centers to power-constrained edge devices. Weight precision plays a critical role in balancing inference accuracy, throughput, and energy consumption, while modern LLM workloads exhibit pronounced heterogeneity and tolerance that favors adaptive precision execution. This paper presents CIMERA, a reconfigurable-precision LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and memory to mitigate the memory wall and enable precision-aware execution. Compared to Nvidia H100, CIMERA delivers up to 25× and 10× higher energy efficiency for 1B and 13B models, respectively.
candidates.reason: CIMERAは再構成可能な精度実行を備えたLLM推論アクセラレータで、コンピュート・イン・インターコネクトとメモリ内計算によりメモリウォールを緩和し、H100比で最大25倍のエネルギー効率を報告する推論ハードウェアとして直接貢献する。

candidates.title: Energy-Efficient Co-Processing: A Hybrid CPUAccelerator Pipeline for Low-Bit Quantized Large Language Model Inference
candidates.venue: 2025 5th International Conference on Ubiquitous Computing and Intelligent Information Systems (ICUIS)
candidates.abstract: The rapid scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly limited by their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper introduces X-Pipe, a novel heterogeneous CPU—Accelerator pipeline architected for ultra-low-bit quantized models (e.g., INT4) to enhance both energy efficiency and throughput. X-Pipe uses fine-grained task partitioning, where the Host CPU takes on control flow, data I/O, and non-linear workloads, while a Domain-Specific Accelerator (DSA) utilizes a collection of high-density linear algebra units. The DSA uses INT4 Multiply—Accumulate (MAC) style units and implements zero-skipping logic based on sparsity patterns, which are common for quantized LLMs. To minimize communication latency, the CPU has custom Instruction Set Extensions (ISEs) for quickly offloading compute kernels. Experiments on transformer-based benchmarks (e.g., Llama-2-7B) demonstrate that X-Pipe achieves a mean improvement of X× in Inferences per Second per Watt (IPS/W) over a state-of-the-art CPU baseline. This work demonstrates the power of a hardware—software co-design effort and enables an efficient and scalable AI inference path for future deployments in a ubiquitous fashion.
candidates.reason: X-PipeはINT4等の超低ビット量子化LLM推論向けに、制御と非線形処理をホストCPU、疎性に基づくゼロスキップ付き高密度線形代数ユニットを専用アクセラレータへ分ける異種CPU-アクセラレータパイプラインであり、低ビット推論ハードウェアへ直接貢献する。
